site.notes: Tradinghouse Substation confirmed at 31.5754137, -96.9636137 (OSM API verified). Ch.313 places project in Axtell ISD (northeast of Waco ~31.66N, 97.13W) which is a different McLennan County location. Axtell ISD coordinates would shift estimate north/west. No direct site address found. The tap is on the 345kV line between Tradinghouse SES (station 13405) and Sam Switch (station 68090) — project site is somewhere along that corridor.

alternate_estimate.notes: Axtell TX is northeast of Waco; Ch.313 applicant is Axtell ISD; Tomas de la Vega survey location unknown precisely

sam_switch.notes: Sam Switch is in Hill County, NOT McLennan County. It is a 345kV switching station off Hill County Road 3165. No OSM/Nominatim result found — no confirmed coordinates.
sam_switch.source: Web search results citing county road reference

infrastructure.tap_notes: The 345kV transmission line runs from Tradinghouse SES (McLennan County) north/northwest to Sam Switch (Hill County). The ERCOT EIR 'Venus Switch to Sam Switch' PDF (Dec 2024) covers a related 38-mile Oncor line in the same corridor.
